_comment: A map that accumulated over three site changes. Each rule was correct when it was added, which is how every map ends up like this.

redirects._comment: 1. A chain. The 2019 URL points at the 2022 URL, which points at the current one. Every hop costs a round trip for users and dilutes what is passed on.
2. A loop, created when someone reversed a rule without removing its opposite. Browsers give up and users see an error page.
3. A 302 on a permanent move. It was meant to be temporary during a launch two years ago.
4. A rule that points at itself, which the server will either reject or serve until it gives up.
5. The same source mapped twice, in two files merged by different people. Which one wins depends on load order.
